title: Samsung recalls and then discontinues the Galaxy Note 7
context: Some Galaxy Note 7 phones overheated and caught fire soon after launch in August 2016.
decision_made: Stop sales and exchanges and discontinue the Note 7 less than two months after launch.
action_taken: Investigated with independent firms and reported the cause in January 2017.
observed_outcome: Samsung estimated the total recall cost at at least $5.3 billion. In January 2017 it said batteries were the cause, with independent investigators agreeing.
lessons: A fast, decisive shutdown can limit further harm, but pushing a design to the limit can be very costly.
limitations: Cost estimates vary (up to $17 billion in some analyst scenarios). Brand and later sales effects were not checked here.

claims.claim_text: Samsung discontinued the Galaxy Note 7 less than two months after launch.
Samsung attributed the fires to batteries in January 2017 and independent investigators agreed.
